about.headline: Over Two Decades of Trusted Escrow Leadership
paragraphs: First Fidelity Escrow is an independent escrow company founded in 2014 by Melissa Carson. With more than 20 years of escrow experience, Melissa partners with many of the highest-producing real estate agents and mortgage lenders in the nation.

Alongside Senior Escrow Officer Nina Latham and Darianne Brewer, our team treats every client like family — answering questions promptly, verifying every detail, and ensuring smooth, stress-free closings.
